name: Larry Page
description: Co-founded Google with Sergey Brin after developing search technology at Stanford.

name: Sergey Brin
description: Co-founded Google with Larry Page; their Stanford research led to PageRank.

name: Amar Bose
description: Founded Bose Corporation and taught at MIT. Earned MIT degrees in 1951, 1952, and 1956.

name: Tim Berners-Lee
description: Inventor of the World Wide Web, listed among Oxford’s notable alumni.

name: Geoffrey Hinton
description: Artificial intelligence researcher and a recipient of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics.

name: Albert Einstein
description: Studied at ETH from 1896 to 1900 and taught theoretical physics there from 1912 to 1914.

name: Alan Turing
relationship: Alumnus and fellow of King’s College
description: Mathematician whose work helped establish the foundations of computer science.

name: Min-Liang Tan
description: Co-founder of Razer and an alumnus of the NUS Faculty of Law.

name: Robin Li
description: Founder of Baidu and an alumnus of Peking University.
